notes.title: Update notes for 0.3.4
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=8o7_5JVrHH8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Planes are back starting with the introduction of an agriculture and firefighting aircraft! Also, the retardant will now stick to the ground, thus letting you create a fire line with it!

[list]
[*] Added agricultural firefighting plane
[*] Retardant now sticks to ground
[*] Added some new static models to level
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for 0.3.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Moved to Unreal 5
[*] You can now use virtual shadow maps to render shadows through the entire forest on high end machines.
[*] Unreal's new Lumen global illumination system is now available, as well as SSGI
[*] Much improved water system
[*] Bambi bucket now has animation
[/list][previewyoutube=rX5cl1AezBE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update notes for 0.2.0
notes.content:
Since I flipped the switch on for multiplayer, I've bumped the version to 0.2.0 from 0.1.0

[list]
[*] Can now toggle music with Backspace key or left D-pad
[*] Added fire damage
[*] Added distance info to airbase icon so you know how far the base is
[*] Can now host / join servers ( most features are not yet implemented for multiplayer but this is a start. )
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for 0.1.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added semi truck w/ hitching ability
[*] Added icon to find home base
[*] Added character locomotion
[*] Added beginning of inventory / stats HUD
[*] Added generic menu system
[*] Can save / load character position
[*] Press ESC for menu ( can change graphics settings / quit game this way, most buttons are disabled for now though )
[*] Graphics settings run a benchmark at game launch and set accordingly
[*] Can die from fall damage
[/list]
